seo_requirements: h1_service_page: include primary keyword + benefit verb
h1_paragraph: 2-3 sentences, includes brand 'Rank Ray', keyword mention
h2_first: question format or benefit statement, includes keyword
h2_paragraph_1: defines the service, includes LSI terms
h2_paragraph_2: connects to related service via internal link
h2_paragraph_3: unique value proposition, differentiator
h3_portfolio_heading: outcome-focused (e.g., 'Success Stories', 'Results')
form_h3_heading: action verb + service name
form_paragraph: 2-3 sentences, includes CTA, brand mention
form_heading_h4: benefit-driven question or command
services_heading_-_h2: keyword + 'Services' or 'Solutions'
before_services_paragraph: 1-2 sentences setting context
Each service heading: specific, benefit-oriented (max 5 words)
Each service paragraph: 2-3 sentences, one may contain internal link
Include keyword or brand, memorable phrase

why_us_section.description: Why Choose Us section with 6 boxes
seo_requirements: why_us_h3_heading: 'Why Choose [Service]?' or 'Why Rank Ray for [Service]?'
why_us_h3_paragraph: 2-3 sentences, brand mention, connects to broader strategy
Each box heading: 2-4 words, benefit-oriented
Each box paragraph: 1-2 sentences, specific (not generic)
faq_heading: '[Service] FAQs' or '[Service] Frequently Asked Questions'
Each question: natural language, 8-15 words
Each answer: 2-4 sentences, direct answer first, then context
Include LSI terms naturally in answers

image_h2_paragraph_3.note: Can be left empty if no relevant image available

word_count_thresholds.note: Service pages are landing pages, not blog posts. 1000-1500 words is optimal.

internal_link_contexts.h2_paragraph_2: Connect to a related service page (different vertical)
internal_link_contexts.services_1_paragraph: Optional: link to a related blog post or service
internal_link_contexts.services_2_paragraph: Optional: link to CRO or related conversion service
internal_link_contexts.services_3_paragraph: Optional: link to email marketing or outreach
internal_link_contexts.services_5_paragraph: Optional: link to digital marketing overview
internal_link_contexts.why_us_h3_paragraph: Optional: link to app development or related tech service
